description.value: Fluid Bar & Grill is a full-service bar and restaurant on Cliffe Avenue in Courtenay, BC, with an eclectic menu spanning tacos, pizza, pasta, burgers, salads, and seafood. The kitchen draws on diverse flavours — from Jambalaya bowls and Kung Pao stir fry to Baked Brie and smoked-meat Reubens — alongside a full bar. Online ordering is available for takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Fluid Bar & Grill is an active, full-service restaurant with a full menu and an 'ORDER ONLINE' feature, supporting takeout. The veggie pizza, veggie kung pao stir fry, and essential greens salad confirm vegetarian options.
